title: Bill the term's fees when the term starts
summary: On the day you set (the start of term), invoice every enrolled student their term's fees exactly once and send each family its invoice with a link to its fees page, then tell the bursar what went out and who was left out.
description: On the day and month you choose, at the time you choose (or by hand from the workflow's page), invoices the current term: one invoice per enrolled student, exactly once, from their class's fees, their optional items and their standing discounts, due on the term's fees due date. A student invoiced already is never invoiced again, so running it a second time, or after students join, invoices only those without one. With Send them now, each family gets its invoice by SMS and email with a fresh link to its fees page, where each child's fees, payments and ways to pay are; otherwise the invoices wait as drafts for a person to check and send from the term's Invoices page. Students left out are counted and said why: no guardian to send to, no fees for their class, nothing to pay after discounts, or a discount waiting for a second person (their invoice is made when it is approved). Then the bursar is told the counts. It runs once a year on that date until you change or turn it off.

params.name: send_day
params.title: Day of the month
params.description: The day the term is invoiced: the first day of term, or a few days before.

params.name: send_month
params.title: Month
params.description: The month, as a number (1 for January, 9 for September).

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the term is invoiced, Lagos time.

params.name: send_now
params.title: Send them now
params.description: Send each family its invoice at once, with a link to its fees page. Off, the invoices wait as drafts for you to check and send.

definition.name: Invoice the term
definition.description: Invoices every enrolled student their term's fees once, sends the families their invoices, and tells the bursar.

input.title: =steps.invoice.output.term + ' invoiced'
input.message: =steps.invoice.output.term + ': ' + string(steps.invoice.output.created) + ' student(s) invoiced now, ' + string(steps.invoice.output.already_invoiced) + ' were invoiced already, ' + string(steps.invoice.output.sent) + ' invoice(s) sent to families' + (steps.invoice.output.failed > 0 ? ' (' + string(steps.invoice.output.failed) + ' could not be sent)' : '') + '. Left out: ' + string(steps.invoice.output.no_contact) + ' with no guardian to send to, ' + string(steps.invoice.output.no_fees) + ' with no fees for their class, ' + string(steps.invoice.output.nothing_to_pay) + ' with nothing to pay, ' + string(steps.invoice.output.needs_approval) + ' waiting for a second person. The Invoices page of the term shows each.'
